description:
Kling V4.0 Flash video generation.

Modes determined by inputs:
- Text-to-video: prompt only
- Image-to-video: prompt + image (first frame)

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video content. A duration set here takes precedence over one named in the prompt.
examples: A cinematic drone shot sweeping over a coastal city at golden hour, waves crashing against the harbor
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: Start frame image for image-to-video. Formats: jpg, jpeg, png. Max 30MB, min 300px per side, aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2.
image.title: Image

aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio. Text-to-video only; with an image the video follows the image.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds (3-20). Billed per second.
duration.title: Duration

title: AppInput
